description: This Dart source file defines an ApiClient class that provides methods for making HTTP GET and POST requests, retrieving raw HTML, and handling JSON content. It uses the HttpClient library, includes support for dynamic base URLs via settings, and manages headers for CORS and content types.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton class providing HTTP API interaction methods, including GET, POST, and raw HTML retrieval, with configurable base URLs and headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to a specified path with optional query parameters and settings override. Parses JSON or returns raw string based on response content type.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON payload to a specified path, using optional settings override. Returns parsed JSON or throws an exception on failure.

methods.name: getRawHtml
methods.description: Retrieves raw HTML (or text) content from a GET request to a specified path with query parameters and settings override.
